content.value_statement: SpecDD task lists can drift from governing specs and local authority. This skill guides agents to locate, interpret, and update task entries within the active spec chain.
actual_capabilities: Find task-bearing Tasks sections in .sdd files for a requested scope.
Resolve bootstrap files before applying SpecDD task rules.
Determine the effective spec chain for a target path or behavior.
Add concise, local, actionable task entries that respect inherited constraints.
Update task status markers for complete, blocked, uncertain, or skipped work.
Report task identifiers, status changes, verification, and remaining blockers.
limitations: Does not adopt SpecDD into a project without explicit operator request.
Does not override governing Must, Must not, Forbids, or write authority rules.
Does not complete unrelated tasks outside the requested target.

use_cases.title: Maintain Spec Task Lists
use_cases.description: Review applicable specs and keep task entries aligned with current project rules.

use_cases.title: Track Feature Work
use_cases.description: Find local tasks for a feature and update status after implementation and checks.

use_cases.title: Review Task Authority
use_cases.description: Confirm that requested task edits are allowed by the active bootstrap and spec chain.

prompt_templates.title: Find Open Tasks
prompt_templates.prompt: Find open SpecDD tasks for the requested area. Read the applicable bootstrap and governing specs before reporting results.

prompt_templates.title: Add Local Tasks
prompt_templates.prompt: Add concise local tasks for this change. Confirm the target spec has write authority and keep each task actionable.

prompt_templates.title: Update Task Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the relevant SpecDD task status after the work. Include verification, blocked items, or unresolved decisions in the report.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Spec Chain Tasks
prompt_templates.prompt: Resolve the full effective spec chain for this target. Identify task-bearing specs, inherited constraints, and the nearest local write authority.

output_examples.input: Find open tasks for the checkout flow.
output_examples.output: The report identifies the governing bootstrap, applicable specs, open checkout tasks, and any blockers or uncertain decisions.

output_examples.input: Mark the completed task after tests pass.
output_examples.output: The response names the updated task, records completion status, summarizes verification, and lists any remaining related tasks.

output_examples.input: Add implementation tasks for the billing migration.
output_examples.output: The result adds local, actionable task entries only where the governing spec grants write authority.

best_practices: Confirm the active bootstrap chain before editing task entries.
Read only governing specs needed for the current decision.
Record verification and unresolved blockers in the final report.
anti_patterns: Creating tasks in a non-SpecDD project without adoption approval.
Marking a task complete before work and checks finish.
Using task text to bypass inherited constraints or write authority.

faq.question: What projects can use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it only in projects that already include a root .specdd/bootstrap.md file.

faq.question: Can it create a new SpecDD setup?
faq.answer: No. It handles existing SpecDD task entries and requires explicit adoption workflow for new projects.

faq.question: How does it choose which specs to read?
faq.answer: It follows the active bootstrap rules and reads governing specs that affect the requested target.

faq.question: Can it mark tasks complete automatically?
faq.answer: It marks completion only after the work and relevant checks are complete.

faq.question: Does it support blocked or uncertain tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses clear task status markers for blocked work, unresolved decisions, and skipped work.

faq.question: What should the final report include?
faq.answer: The report should include task identifiers or exact task text, status changes, verification, and remaining blockers.
